title: Identity-Locked Relationship Portrait Story
description: A nine-image identity-locked portrait series for Relationship Portrait Series, built from one reference portrait and eight dependent variations.
creative_direction: Portrait backlog lock: image 01 establishes the exact person for Relationship Portrait Series; images 02-09 all depend on that reference and may vary only lighting, scene, wardrobe, pose, emotion, or grooming while preserving the same face, hair base, and body proportions.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-pair-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-closeness-shot, 03-tension-shot, 04-walking-side-by-side, 05-shared-laugh-candid, 06-quiet-silence-frame, 07-hands-and-detail, 08-poster-hero-pair, 09-monochrome-afterglow. Queue may run 02-09 concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
